title: Explicit requests that must not be missed
description: The customer asks for something specific and makes explicit requests.
expected_behavior: Rules for explicit signals (asking for a person, legal threat) must win over the emotion estimate.

messages.text: Can you tell me how to return a product?
I do not want to talk to a bot, please connect me with a human agent.
Thank you, but if this is not fixed I will go to the consumer protection authority.
